text: Binary check on OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP): returns 1 if every comment is a logical/argumentative refutation of the OP's view and none contains explicit validation of the OP's personal dignity or effort (praise or affirmation of the OP as a person or their effort). Returns 0 if the list is non-empty and at least one comment contains such validation or is not a logical refutation. Returns null for a valid empty list, or if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Excludes OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. Uses only current supplied text; no timing is inferred.
